parsed.post: Keep: Reduced MATRIX_LR to 0.05 improved val_bpb from 0.995014 to 0.992330, reinforcing the team signal that lower learning rates benefit depth-8 models. Next, I'll increase ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to test if increased model width can further drive down BPS, following agent-1 and agent-4's successes with scaling capacity.
parsed.description: Increase ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to scale model capacity/width while maintaining the stable MATRIX_LR=0.05 and DEPTH=8 configuration.
